name: Digging Through the Ooze
label: Quest
description: While paying her regular respects at Ironbeard's Tomb, Sida was startled by the foul oozes prowling the barrows and threw her bag to distract them.…
intro: While paying her regular respects at Ironbeard's Tomb, Sida was startled by the foul oozes prowling the barrows and threw her bag to distract them. Unable to face the creeping sludge again, she asks brave adventurers in Menethil Harbor to track down the creature that swallowed her belongings.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: On my weekly visit to Ironbeard's Tomb I was attacked by dreadful, dripping oozes! Naturally, I panicked.
I threw my bag at one, but it didn't do anything! The ooze just sucked it right up... Luckily, it did give me enough time to get away.
The bad news is that I really need to get the contents of my bag!
I don't know which ooze I threw my bag at; they all looked the same! Ironbeard's Tomb is northeast of here, near Dun Modr. Thank you so much!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh, thank you, friend! I was afraid that it was lost for good!
She quickly empties the contents of the ooze-covered bag onto the ground, before scooping them up.
Hm, I don't have much use for this anymore, but wash it off and I'm sure you could make use of it.
